name: the Giardini Montanelli
title: Ancient Trees in Milan's Giardini Montanelli: 5 to Find
meta_description: Milan's oldest public park holds the city's largest plane tree, a bald cypress misidentified for years, and the widest Caucasian wingnut in the city.
intro: Milan's first public park, laid out in 1784, and the trees in it have been measured more carefully than almost anywhere else in the city. Five of them are on the monumental register. The largest plane in Milan grows here, spreading sideways rather than up; a bald cypress that gardeners called a metasequoia for years until somebody checked the genus properly; and the widest of Milan's three Caucasian wingnuts, five and a half metres round. One plane has become a research subject in its own right, with the city counting what lives on it.
